about: Patterns only, reviewed by hand: lines GuestTest2's log sweep drops, as re.search over a normalized line (guest_judge.normalize: numbers are N, hex HEX, times TIME). all and host: every guest (host: below); the others by the spec's checks.pm. A pattern marked list: also drops the indented lines under the line it matches (package names, wrapped). A new pattern re-runs only those guests. Keep it package-manager chatter: a real error must never match. The accepted per-guest lines are never here: they live on the Mac (guest-baselines), since they can hold machine IDs and hostnames.

hbsd, ld-elf.so.1's Tainted line: at every boot, /etc/rc.d/ldconfig (FreeBSD 15's) asks the run-time linker for its default path with /libexec/ld-elf.so.1 -v, and HardenedBSD's rtld refuses to be run directly while hardening.harden_rtld is 1, its default (sysctl hardening.harden_rtld=0 makes the same command print 'Default lib path /lib:/usr/lib'; seen on hardenedbsd15 and hardenedbsd15-zfs, GuestTest2 t2v-20261118T0027-d7c8, before and after the update).  Harmless: the hints file then lacks /lib and /usr/lib, which rtld searches anyway as its built-in default

host, every guest's whatever its package manager: lines that say what host the guest was placed on (its CPU, the firmware QEMU gives it, its clocks), never what the guest or its update did.  One guest landing on a host it hadn't run on made them new, though the same line was accepted on other guests: in GuestTest2 passes 4-6 of 2026-11-18 (t2v-20261118T0617-4a11, -0942-226e, -1159-2749) the Ryzen 5600H hosts' (chopin, cinqcent) unstable-TSC and CPU-feature lines, amd_pstate's CPPC lines on every AMD host, choubox's Intel CPU in a BSD's boot banner, chronyd stepping a clock the host set.  And what a BSD loader's spinner leaves of its console output (normalize erases what a backspace does, but the loader's dual console writes each character twice, the spinner unevenly between them, as fast as the host loads): a line of spinner characters alone, and its doubled lines ('//bboooott//kkeerrnneell//zzffss..kkoo ssiizzee ...'), unless a doubled error word is in one.  Kept out on purpose: a kernel WARNING, BUG or oops and its trace, even one the host's CPU triggers (choubox's Intel ITS thunks give 'CPA detected W^X violation' with a WARNING in set_memory.c: it is classed per guest, or fixed), failed units, I/O and file system errors.  Each pattern is the whole line's form, anchored, so a real error in the same words never matches (test_guest_judge.HostLines)

tukit (aeon, microos): transactional-update runs zypper inside its snapshot, so zypper's patterns, and its scriptlets' and preloads' progress lines (GuestTest2 t2v-20261118T1159-2749: spec.json named #tukit before there was one, so these guests had only all's and host's)

guix (guix15, guix15-bios): guix pull's and guix system reconfigure's chatter (substitute lookups, progress bars, download rates, /gnu/store paths, grafts, profile hooks, activation, Shepherd's service starts) from both guests' 2026-11-14 update.logs on Chopin.  Kept out on purpose: Guile backtraces (In ..., N:N N (...)), 'guix system: warning:' and error lines.  truenas (truenas25, truenas25-mirror): empty until the first probe boot's journal shows the middleware's chatter
